mission_priority: XRP intelligence and measured prediction-engine mastery
foundation: Barrot V3 execution, verification, security and preservation

market_snapshot.interpretation: Non-synchronous provider snapshots; no averaged or canonical spot price is asserted.

partial_contract_observation.caveat: Partial two-contract sub-universe; not a competing global OI total.

interpretation: The 2.42x spread among three broad multi-exchange aggregators is material and cannot be resolved by averaging.
Coverage differs by venue and contract: USDT and USDC perps, contract inclusion and source timestamp differ.
Funding is not uniform: Binance positive and Bybit negative in the partial Coinalyze observation.
Account-count long/short ratios do not measure notional positioning; taker buy shares below 50% in the two reported contracts do not by themselves establish net market direction.
TradRadar reports long liquidations materially exceeding short liquidations, but liquidation data is incomplete/venue-limited.

mid_market_findings.binance: Deepest at market price in the report.
mid_market_findings.bybit_and_kraken: Each reported below $100,000 at zero price deviation.

exchange_liquidity.interpretation: Coinbase has a documented near-mid XRP liquidity strength in this dated report, while Binance remains deeper at the touch. This supports a tactical liquidity/market-quality role, not price control or proof of current live depth.

observations.tracked_products: 6 US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW XRP sleeve
observations.method: Issuer holdings day-over-day change; flow-excluded funds contribute zero to totals; reconstructed intervals use third-party estimates.

observations.caveat: Listed categories sum to 11, not 12; product universe includes non-spot products and is not comparable to spot holdings-derived flow totals.

etf_flows.interpretation: ETF flow observations differ by product universe, fund coverage, settlement status and holdings-delta methodology. No canonical November 2 daily net flow is assigned. AUM, trust holdings, secondary-market trading volume and primary creations/redemptions remain separate variables.

protocol.caveat: Requires continuous validator support; verify the actual validated-ledger EnableAmendment transaction.
protocol.paymentburn_scope: Issued trust-line tokens and MPTs, not native XRP supply.

model_policy.no_averaging: Keep provider OI and ETF universes separate until coverage, contract, timestamp and methodology are reconciled.
model_policy.point_in_time: Store source timestamp, retrieval timestamp, provider, contract universe, quote currency, unit, coverage and raw snapshot hash.
model_policy.feature_eligibility: No derivatives aggregate or ETF daily flow becomes a forecast feature until synchronized and validated.

caveats: The CoinGecko liquidity report is dated September 30 and is not a live order-book snapshot.
Provider OI coverage and contract definitions differ; broad totals are not comparable without reconciliation.
ETF holdings deltas are not identical to unhedged investor conviction or exchange spot purchases.
No price forecast or trading recommendation is issued.
